Cannot download the server's Workshop items from %1:
%2

UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Restart:
To use the server's version of %1, restart the game: Java code can only be loaded when the game starts.
Once it has started again, choose Rejoin on the main menu.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Preload:
%1 (in %2) loads at game start and cannot be taken from a server.
Ask the server owner to restart the server, which updates the item.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_NotServ:
The game runs the Java code of %1 from %2, not the server's version (details in console.txt).
Restart the game and join again.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_NotLoad:
The game did not load the Java code of %1 (%2) when it started, so it cannot run the server's version. Was it declined in ZombieBuddy's dialog? (details in console.txt)
Restart the game and join again.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Refused:
%1 carries %2, which is never taken from the server.
Ask the server owner to restart the server, which updates the item.
